data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store, my overall recommendation is **Stripe**, unless you're already using Shopify, in which case I'd choose **Shopify Payments**\.

If you're operating in Australia, there are a few particularly good options worth comparing.

## Best payment processors for a small Australian online store

![Stripe Conversion Tracking – Able Customer Data Platform](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uLblf37t9qmSgXH90IIrfyM1cEVlAyfeKTR0KIuJzNcMC_B2ZUJW9p7BftOV-yzXikVmn2jDYU_Zq1ExkRO0GTjHIMaYqcU4RzMNo1YrpDxk3GXGSNzey-FFdr644M2DVq4UsY3Zo9OE1wDfp2BQqWf9beRf_8lKhubJp-AjxGHf8Zwil7Ew0fyQc0BJ2PlA?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Easy integration with most online stores.
- No standard monthly processing subscription.
- Supports cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay.
- Excellent reporting, fraud protection and recurring payments.

Indicative domestic card fee: **1.65% + A\$0.30**\. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Stripe Australia](https://stripe.com/au)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify.
- Simple refunds and payment management.
- Supports major cards and digital wallets.
- Avoids additional Shopify third-party transaction fees.

Indicative Basic plan domestic online card fee: **1.75% + A\$0.30**\. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Shopify Payments Australia](https://www.shopify.com/au/payments)

---

![Airwallex enters South Korean market with Paynuri acquisition](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/D_4VHtA0SeOgicDFzw011KJjQsOKBcSueMkln4sAfXodLPEEa3t7NtMxla-fIF5UWu0iXuS_YfYtmjw0S_rQ80_HadZtbc68lQEKKReC4CqTEUwGZOTEsoS2QB_Jg1eQrkNfUqjqLxuL1E_IdkYV3XpPRgzm363kqM09FHLONA7S51LtpUhmis0bGr00iqMt?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Airwallex**

(Best for international sales)

- Excellent multi-currency capabilities.
- Useful for international suppliers and customers.
- Integrates with ecommerce platforms.
- Supports international payment methods.

Indicative domestic card fee: **1.65% + A\$0.30**\. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Airwallex Australia](https://www.airwallex.com/au)

---

![PayPal | 2024 Campus Forward Award Winner](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1CZkwu4XfsGi29HQm25jVqzyfcoAVt94osIFdG4Jj8i1ykjiTdkMc0sAUQttosT9d7348BNtDTI_LMzAYAAVQSAaA7t0VR8tZ2dLSQA2uJQWzrGyAfk_RjRmQZRYTdvd5dOIPliOCiFgcYeRgEL5JmA0u2Gw-Vro7HrBA62cIt2eLuB_AGLmV7TK3132kofQ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PayPal**

- Recognised and trusted by many shoppers.
- Convenient additional checkout option.
- Useful for international customers.

Indicative domestic fee: **2.90% + A\$0.30**\. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[PayPal Business Australia](https://www.paypal.com/au/business)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down like this\:

| Your situation | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Shopify store | Shopify Payments |
| WooCommerce store | Stripe |
| Custom-built website | Stripe |
| Lots of international customers | Airwallex |
| Want another trusted payment option | Add PayPal |


**One important tip\:** Don't choose purely on transaction fees. Look at international card surcharges, currency conversion, chargeback fees, settlement times and integration costs too.
